Chapter 6928: My Grandmaster Is Breaker Immortal

Chapter 6928: My Grandmaster Is Breaker Immortal

Star focused his gaze and unleashed a waterfall-like sword energy forward. It could instantly decapitate ten million mortals in the blink of an eye.

“Pop!” However, it couldn’t move his robe. This was less effective than a fart.

“What?” The three exchanged glances and immediately unsheathed their blades.

These blades could be considered divine in any firmament. A regular cultivator could become as strong as an emperor with their help. They illuminated space; their presence became obvious to all cultivators.

Living beings wondered what had angered their sword gods.

“Go for it.” Li Qiye said.

“Die! Star Break!” Star made the first move, angered by the impudent mortal. His sword was made from countless stars.

The slash unleashed a blinding light, capable of turning the dimension into a sieve or killing thousands of emperors and ancient ancestors.

“Bam!” However, it stopped before Li Qiye despite him using all of his strength.

The other two sword gods found this ridiculous and dreadful.

“Solar Blaze!” Sun made his move, slashing and releasing countless suns. The flames alone could incinerate anything and everything.

Moon joined in as well. However, his attack was less conspicuous. All of a sudden, his blade appeared above Li Qiye, ready to pierce through him from top to bottom. It aimed for the most defenseless blind spot with time-surpassing speed.

The same thing happened - both stopped right before reaching Li Qiye.

They still didn’t give up and channeled all of their energy into the blades, going as far as burning their true blood.

“Rumble!” Their immense power and sword dao tore apart space. Unfortunately, the same outcome shocked them.

They wouldn’t have believed it if they hadn’t experienced it just now. The man couldn’t possibly be a mortal.

“Who are you?!” They shouted in unison.

“You lost your chance.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Rumble!” The swords shattered automatically even when he did nothing.

The trio’s eyes widened in disbelief. These swords were made from their supreme grand dao. An immortal shouldn’t be able to break them down instantly.

Thus, they realized they had met a monster. Chill coursed down their spine as they tried to run. They came to find themselves fully immobilized somehow.

There seemed to be an invisible hand gripping them tightly. Just a bit of force and they would be crushed.

“What are you doing?!” They screamed.

“I just want to know where Perpetual Immortal is.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We will tell you our master’s location!” They said.

“No need, I will just grab it from your memories.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“No!!!” They shouted, aware of his intention.

“It’s not up to you, you didn’t seize the chance earlier.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Dao Brother!” They shouted at Timeflow, hoping for help.

He simply waved his hand and didn’t bother since they weren’t his friends.

“My grandmaster is Breaker Immortal!” They had to bring up their grandmaster.
